event.piper_heart8.intro.text: Pull a chair up by the stage. I'm writing a new one, and not alone this time. Alone is how you end up rhyming 'parsnip'.
event.piper_heart8.intro.why: heart5.0 already opens with 'Sit.'; two scenes opened on the same word

event.overheard_piper_juno_2.l1.text: I wrote a song to your hammer's rhythm, Juno! Don't stop!
event.overheard_piper_juno_2.l1.why: all three juno overheards opened with 'Juno'; juno_1 keeps the address

event.overheard_piper_juno_3.l1.text: Did you build me a tiny stage, Juno? Out of a crate?
event.overheard_piper_juno_3.l1.why: third 'Juno' opener in the chain; moved the name inside

event.overheard_piper_juno_3.l3.text: Then it gets my best set! Best seat's yours, Juno. Sit!
event.overheard_piper_juno_3.l3.why: 'Front row's yours' is my phrase for the player (birthday, partners); giving it to Juno diluted it

event.overheard_hazel_piper_3.l1.text: Write me one verse, Hazel. Just one. Your words, my tune.
event.overheard_hazel_piper_3.l1.why: hazel_1 already opens with 'Hazel!'; Hazel's reply still lands unchanged

event.piper_courtship.after.text: {if flag:choice.courtship.piper.yes}A love song, rhymed and bridged. You'll hear it Friday. It's unbearable. You'll love it.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.piper.friends}The best duet going, then. Wren will still charge us both for the good stool.{else}Take your time. I'll hum while I wait. Quietly. Mostly.{/if}{/if}
event.piper_courtship.after.why: friends and later branches opened on the same word as r1/r2 directly before them

event.piper_courtship2.after.text: {if flag:choice.courtship.piper.yes}Finally! That love song's been in the case since you said 'a verse or two'. Tonight it comes out.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.piper.friends}A duet, then. Some songs are better that way. I'm keeping the second verse anyway.{else}Still a verse or two? Then the last line stays blank. Some songs end better late.{/if}{/if}
event.piper_courtship2.after.why: friends branch opened 'Friends' right after the shared r1 line opening 'Friends'

event.piper_partners.after.text: {if choice:courtship.piper.song}Your name's in the bridge. The bridge is the best part. That's not an accident.{else}{if choice:courtship.piper.duet}We sang the chorus together, and the room came in behind us. I forgot to play for a bar. Worth it.{else}Under the stars, I hummed. You hummed back. Best accompaniment I've ever had.{/if}{/if}
event.piper_partners.after.why: walk branch repeated r2's 'A walk home' opener back to back

event.piper_birthday.after.text: {if choice:bday.piper.wish}Your wish made the encore. I rhymed 'birthday' with 'worth the day'. Don't check.{else}{if choice:bday.piper.sing}My song in your voice. The room clapped for you, and I liked that better. Don't tell the fiddle.{else}A song's coming with your name in it. Don't ask when. It will rhyme. Eventually.{/if}{/if}
event.piper_birthday.after.why: 'stood there, grinning like a lantern' collided with my shipped heart-10 lamp-post line

threads.piper_heart2: Friday, chord two — the honest one — is waiting.
threads.piper_heart5: The song ends on four notes she never wrote and can't place.
threads.piper_heart4: She wrote the request down and says it matters later.
threads.piper_heart6: She wants a song they sing without her; the nerves only got smaller.
threads.piper_heart8: The new song still needs a room to sing it without her.
threads.piper_heart10: The village owns the song now; what she writes next is open.
threads.piper_friend: Verse five, next Friday, is about the player.
threads.piper_birthday: A song with the player's name in it is coming, on a musician's schedule.
threads.piper_courtship: The love song stays in the case until the answer changes.
threads.piper_courtship2: The last line of the coward's song stays blank, on purpose.
threads.piper_partners: The player's name sits in the bridge, and the bridge is the best part.
threads.story_umbrella: Someone keeps hanging the umbrella up neatly and folds the ribbon.
threads.story_band_battle: Bram tapped his foot on the second verse and will deny it until spring.
threads.overheard_wren_piper_1: The bridge is going up a key, out of spite.
threads.overheard_wren_piper_2: Wren can write a verse; Piper will open with it, credit in tiny letters.
threads.overheard_wren_piper_3: Someone fixes Piper's rhymes in pencil, and she has stopped asking who.
threads.overheard_wren_piper_4: The headline night needs Wren's second verse first.
